sources.entry: 25. Artist refference Spreadsheet - A comprehensive Google Spreadsheet with refferences of artist styles

summary.name: Midjourney Artist Influence Reference Sheets
summary.one_liner: A Google Spreadsheet listing about 65 artists whose styles are compared against Midjourney prompt outputs, with a grid of generated test images by artist and prompt phrase.
use_cases: Checking how a named artist's style looks in Midjourney before prompting with it
Comparing artist styles across prompt phrases like character concept art or charcoal
Finding a list of artist names to use in image prompts
Studying how prompt wording changes AI art output
summary.what_it_does: The sheet has a header row describing the test conditions: prompts were run with --test --seed 123 --ar 2:3 in Midjourney. Columns test phrases such as "character by", "rough charcoal by", "pencil character sketch by", and "character concept art by". Rows list about 65 artists, from Salomon van Abbé to Coby Whitmore, with a column for the artist name and a link to a newer V4 version of the sheet. The page text shows the artist names and prompt headers only; the generated image cells do not appear in the extracted text. The sheet also includes a note asking viewers to credit the artists and a contact handle for comments.
notable: Side-by-side artist style tests using fixed Midjourney seed and aspect ratio
Covers about 65 classic and contemporary illustrators and painters
Points to a newer V4 version of the sheet
caveats: Image results are not visible in the extracted text, so the style outputs cannot be verified from this page
Tests were run with Midjourney conditions from an earlier version; the page links to a newer V4 sheet
Artist names are listed without descriptions of their styles
